concerns.location: tasks.md:T001–T012 vs constitution.md:Reproducibility Requirements / Principle VII
concerns.text: No task creates the pinned dependency manifest. The constitution requires 'A requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/PROJ-132.../code/ pins every Python dependency' and Principle VII requires 'exact package versions... pinned in requirements.txt'. T001 creates config.py but no task writes code/requirements.txt, so this requirement has no implementing task.

Spec scenario 2 requires that Moran's I > 0.15 'triggers a re-fit with a Gaussian Process (GP) random effect using a Matérn covariance function'. T006 only computes Moran's I and 'flags models with Moran's I > 0.15'; no task implements the conditional re-fit behavior, so this acceptance scenario has no covering task.

plan.md specifies a src/-rooted layout (src/config.py, src/data/download.py, src/models/manifold.py, src/utils/locks.py, tests/contract|integration|unit). Every task builds under code/ instead, and no amendment or deviation record covers the structural change — an implementer following plan.md's structure produces files no task verifies. Also plan.md's filelock locking (data/.pipeline.lock, utils/locks.py) has no corresponding task.

Principle VI requires archived raw-data metadata including 'sensor version' (dataset version) for eBird and climate files. T002's data_availability_report.json records only 'streaming/sampling rule used (which split, chunk size, row counts)'; no task records species/date-range/geographic-extent/sensor-version metadata for the archived raw files.

US-1 scenario 1 requires verifying 'a minimum of 208 weeks of data per grid cell' and phenology metrics for a minimum percentage of species-year combinations. T003's verification checks only parquet columns and unit tests; no task measures or asserts weekly coverage or species-year metric coverage, so the scenario's verification clause is uncovered.

Plan's State Synchronization steps (state/projects/PROJ-132...yaml artifact_hashes updates) are removed as 'platform-owned'. Constitution Principle V and the Data Hygiene section make the state-file artifact_hashes map a project-level requirement; if genuinely platform-owned, tasks.md should cite where this is handled rather than silently dropping it.
